seal.statement: Scenario A latency and efficiency research has a valid substrate and honest records. A research profile class, dispatch family and subkind exist that admission refuses by one explicit reason and the record writer refuses to place in the published store. The runner accepts --profile research (one fresh deployment per run on the existing lifecycle; the dry run prints the frozen plan and that nothing is admissible; --storage-root and a passed semantic gate are required). Three Lagrange nodes run on one lab host as a first look, on a campaign-scoped Docker bridge network (created and removed by the campaign's own deployment and cleanup owners, labelled with the campaign; a leftover network is a closure failure), each node declaring its own distinct SYNTHETIC host identity (declared host count 3), standard ports on each node's own bridge address, the load generator on the same host; the machine's real host name and the fact that the identities are synthetic are recorded in the substrate descriptor, the run record and the report text. This substrate exists only for the research class and only with evidenceUse first-look; every non-research plan and every multi-host plan refuses synthetic identities and keeps the observed machine name. Every run records a substrate descriptor and a round-trip matrix (the load-generator-to-endpoint path and every ordered node pair, on the bridge for one host) measured before and after the window, never during it (seven entries for three nodes on either substrate: six ordered node pairs and the load generator to the endpoint). The dataset reset method is reported by the adapter that performed it. Every statement carries a monotonic start and end in a per-attempt timeline indexed into a per-run statement catalog. Retained statement evidence of every profile is brought into the campaign evidence beside the raw record, digest-verified, before the load-generator worktree is released, and a missing or mismatching file is a typed evidence failure. An unverified seed is never warmed up or measured. Every research plan and record names its substrate kind on a ladder (owner, 2026-11-28): lab-single-host (a first look; the report of such a run says so and no speed or efficiency claim stands on it), lab-multi-host (three separate lab hosts, one node each, load generator on a fourth machine that is not a product host; the working evidence, run repeatedly with its measured round trip recorded every time) and gcp-same-zone (final verification). Physical evidence: one COMPLETED first-look research run on one lab host and one completed run on three separate lab hosts; runs that did not complete because of the network are recorded and kept beside it and satisfy nothing.

text: Research profile class with admission and store barriers; substrate ladder with a synthetic-identity single-host first look, three separate hosts as working evidence and same-zone cloud as final verification; descriptor and round-trip matrix per run; adapter-reported reset method; per-statement timeline; custody of retained statement evidence; seed verification before warm-up; guard and witnesses; runbook text; the record files of the two superseded predecessors; generated outputs; the epic's quest list.
